title: jstack-cli playbook locate --json
description: The step a quote names in the computed playbook, and the file each active layer would hold an edit to it in.

step.description: The step's number in the computed playbook.

text.description: The step's text after every layer.

layers.description: One entry per active layer, in cascade order.

path.description: The layer's file that already edits the playbook, or the path a new one takes. Team files read through a checkout are relative to its root. null when the checkout has no org or repo for this layer.

problem.description: Why an edit in this layer cannot anchor on the quote, judged against the layers below it. null when it can.
